supplements.title: Effect of stereochemistry at position C14 on the antiproliferative activity and selectivity of simplified oridonin O-acylated derivatives.
supplements.summary: C14α-configured oridonin derivatives showed enhanced antiproliferative activity against SU-DHL-6 lymphoma cells, with compound 6k demonstrating the most potent effect.

supplements.title: Digitally Delivered Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Inflammation-Guided Nutrition to Enhance Recovery and Survival After Abdominoperineal Resection (APR): A Prospective Non-Randomized Controlled Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: For low rectal cancer patients after surgery, a digital therapy app and personalized nutrition plan reduced inflammation and improved recovery and potential survival outcomes.

supplements.title: Impact of Perioperative Nutrition Intervention on Bioimpedance Phase Angle in Patients With Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review.
supplements.summary: Targeted nutrition support during breast cancer treatment may improve patient health by preserving cellular integrity, as measured by bioimpedance phase angle.

supplements.title: Recommendations from the European interdisciplinary council on ageing on physical activity and diet for mental health conditions in older adults.
supplements.summary: Regular physical activity and Mediterranean diet interventions can help prevent and manage mental health conditions and cognitive decline in older adults.

supplements.title: Exercise training decreases Neuregulin-1 concentrations in HER2-positive breast cancer patients undergoing adjuvant trastuzumab: the CARDAPAC study.
supplements.summary: Exercise training reduced Neuregulin-1 levels in HER2-positive breast cancer patients receiving trastuzumab, potentially mitigating treatment-related heart damage.

supplements.title: Morin induces ferroptosis in endometrial cancer cells by down-regulating FTH1.
supplements.summary: Morin triggers cell death in endometrial cancer by reducing FTH1 protein levels, potentially offering a new targeted treatment approach.

supplements.title: Untargeted mass spectrometry to investigate ocean acidification in Cancer borealis using optimized metabolite extraction methods.
supplements.summary: In Cancer borealis, ocean acidification triggered metabolic changes in 15 metabolites, with isopropanol extraction revealing potential stress response pathways.

supplements.title: Ultra-processed food and mortality among long-term cancer survivors from the Moli-sani Study: prospective findings and analysis of biological pathways.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence for this research:

Higher consumption of ultra-processed foods was linked to increased mortality risk among cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Effects of probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics on P53 and KI-67 in colorectal cancer: a scoping review.
supplements.summary: Probiotics and related supplements may influence colorectal cancer progression by modulating tumor cell proliferation and apoptosis through key molecular markers.

supplements.title: Proteomic antibacterial characterization of flavonoid xanthohumol and probiotic Clostridium butyricum on pathogenic Clostridioides difficile.
supplements.summary: Xanthohumol and Clostridium butyricum combined effectively inhibit the growth of harmful Clostridioides difficile bacteria in the gut.

supplements.title: Testicular ageing as a central hallmark of male senescence: characteristics, molecular mechanisms and emerging therapeutic strategies.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers are exploring how testicular aging occurs and seeking potential interventions to slow or reverse age-related decline in male reproductive function.

supplements.title: Targeting Hsp70 triggers ferroptosis: a novel anti-cancer mechanism of a marine natural product in prostate cancer.
supplements.summary: A marine compound called nidurufin targets HSP70, disrupting the AR signaling pathway and triggering ferroptosis in prostate cancer cells.

supplements.title: Gambogic acid ameliorates hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting oxidative stress via Nrf2-pSmad2C/2L pathway.
supplements.summary: Gambogic acid effectively reduces liver cancer progression by inhibiting oxidative stress through a specific cellular signaling pathway in experimental models.

supplements.title: Natural and synthetic compounds targeting ferroptosis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: Research progress and application potential.
supplements.summary: Natural and synthetic compounds targeting ferroptosis show promise in killing esophageal cancer cells and potentially improving treatment outcomes.

supplements.title: Structure-Guided optimization of PAO-PDT yields TrxR inhibitors as potential anticancer agent.
supplements.summary: By combining organoarsenic compounds with cinnamic acid, researchers developed a potent TrxR inhibitor (As-CA11) that induces cancer cell death by disrupting cellular redox balance.

off_label.title: New mechanistic insights into targeted protein degradation using Raman-active theranostic hydrophobic tags.
off_label.summary: A new hydrophobic tag coupled with olaparib more effectively degrades PARP-1 in ovarian cancer cells, enhancing anti-cancer activity through targeted protein removal.

off_label.title: Exploring dual inhibitors Carbonic Anhydrases and Phosphodiesterase 5 as potential agents for treatment Alzheimer's disease.
off_label.summary: A novel dual-targeting drug compound 8a shows promise in reducing memory loss and brain cell damage in Alzheimer's disease by inhibiting two key enzymes.

off_label.title: Evaluation of metformin's effect on 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity through cellular protection.
off_label.summary: Metformin may protect heart cells from damage caused by 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy, potentially reducing toxic side effects during cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Repositioning GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Endometrial Cancer: Molecular Rationale, Preclinical Insights, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating endometrial cancer by targeting tumor growth and metabolic dysfunction in obesity-related cases.

off_label.title: HDAC Inhibition Triggers Release of RNA Polymerase II from Promoter-Proximal Pausing in Healthy Blood Progenitors and Primary Acute Myeloid Leukemia Myeloblasts.
off_label.summary: HDAC inhibitor SAHA triggers RNA polymerase release in both healthy and acute myeloid leukemia cells, potentially explaining limited clinical effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pharmacogenomic Synthetic Lethal Screens Reveal Hidden Vulnerabilities and New Therapeutic Approaches for Treatment of NF1-Associated Tumors.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified 23 drugs that selectively kill NF1-deficient Schwann cells, revealing promising therapeutic approaches for neurofibromatosis type I-associated tumors.

off_label.title: Repurposing of the Macrolide Antibiotic Clarithromycin for the Prevention of Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: In a mouse model, the antibiotic clarithromycin prevented KRAS-mutant lung cancer by reducing inflammation and altering the microbiome.

off_label.title: Delactylation of the tumor suppressor ARHGDIB drives metastasis and chemoresistance in bladder cancer.
off_label.summary: In bladder cancer, HDAC2-mediated removal of lactylation from ARHGDIB promotes cancer spread and cisplatin resistance by activating DNA repair mechanisms.

off_label.title: Disproportionality analysis of semaglutide-associated bile-duct cancer: A vigibase study.
off_label.summary: A pharmacovigilance analysis investigated potential links between semaglutide, a diabetes medication, and bile duct cancer occurrence using worldwide adverse event reporting data.

off_label.title: Natural polysaccharide riclin acts as an immune adjuvant to enhance chemotherapy efficacy in NSCLC.
off_label.summary: Riclin, a natural polysaccharide, enhances gemcitabine's effectiveness in lung cancer by boosting immune function and reducing tumor burden.

off_label.title: Applying biotechnology to overcome cancer drug resistance and improve public health outcomes.
off_label.summary: Biotechnology innovations like CRISPR, targeted therapies, and immunotherapies can help overcome cancer drug resistance and improve treatment effectiveness across different healthcare settings.

off_label.title: Synergistic effects of anticoagulants and platelet aggregation inhibitors with immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer therapy: a comprehensive review of preclinical and clinical evidence.
off_label.summary: Anticoagulants may enhance immune checkpoint inhibitors' effectiveness in cancer treatment by improving immune cell infiltration and reducing tumor spread.

off_label.title: Calcium Channel Blockers Inhibit Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Progression via Cav1.2-Epigenetic Circuit.
off_label.summary: Calcium channel blockers, particularly amlodipine, significantly inhibit pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasm progression by disrupting a key cellular signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Integrated regulation of ferroptosis in prostate cancer covering mechanisms, resistance, and translational opportunities.
off_label.summary: Researchers discovered that targeting specific molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis could offer new treatment strategies for improving prostate cancer therapy and patient outcomes.

off_label.title: Age-stratified clinical outcomes and adverse events in patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer receiving triplet therapy with darolutamide, androgen deprivation therapy, and docetaxel.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

In metastatic prostate cancer, older and younger patients receiving a triple drug combination showed similar treatment responses and manageable side effects.

biomarkers.title: Time-resolved simultaneous imaging of mitochondrial reactive oxygen species and lysosomal permeabilization to determine organelle-centred cell death.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers developed a new imaging technique to simultaneously track mitochondrial and lysosomal changes during cell death, revealing potential insights for understanding cellular destruction.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of targeted and immune combination therapies in a rat model of hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In a rat breast cancer model, fulvestrant combined with an immune checkpoint inhibitor showed the most effective tumor regression and treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Switchable Electrode-Enabled High-Density Two-Dimensional Chips: A Simple, Generalizable Approach to Yield High-Throughput Electrochemical Analyses.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a microfluidic chip with switchable electrodes that successfully monitored cancer cell (MDA-MB-231) proliferation through a high-density, compact sensor design.

biomarkers.title: Harnessing the role of insulin-like growth factor in glioblastoma: a comprehensive review.
biomarkers.summary: Targeting the IGF system, particularly IGFBP-2 and its signaling pathways, may offer a promising therapeutic approach for treating aggressive glioblastoma.

biomarkers.title: An Eye-Opening Approach: Cancer of Unknown Primary Source With Choroidal Metastasis Case Report.
biomarkers.summary: A 33-year-old patient with choroidal metastasis from lung cancer achieved long-term disease control through multimodal treatment combining immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and targeted radiation.

biomarkers.title: DNA origami vaccines program antigen-focused germinal centers.
biomarkers.summary: DNA origami nanoparticles displaying an HIV envelope protein effectively primed rare B cells that could generate broadly neutralizing antibodies in mouse models.

biomarkers.title: KMT2C Loss Promotes NF2-Wildtype Meningioma Progression and Ferroptosis Sensitivity via Epigenetic Repression of Hippo Signaling.
biomarkers.summary: KMT2C loss in NF2-wildtype meningiomas promotes cancer progression by reducing NF2 transcription and increasing sensitivity to cell death.

biomarkers.title: Isolation and characterization of broadly-neutralizing anti-HCMV-gB antibodies from human donors using a prefusion-stabilized HCMV gB variant.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers isolated new antibodies targeting human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) using a modified viral protein, revealing potential strategies for preventing and treating HCMV infections.

biomarkers.title: SIRT7 as a context-dependent biomarker and therapeutic target: Insights from a pan-cancer study.
biomarkers.summary: In a pan-cancer study, SIRT7 was found to have context-dependent roles in cancer progression, with potential as a biomarker and therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: TGF-β1 relieves burn injury induced pain by alleviating inflammation in mouse.
biomarkers.summary: TGF-β1 reduces pain and inflammation in burn injury by suppressing pro-inflammatory factors and promoting anti-inflammatory responses in a mouse model.

biomarkers.title: Laboratory diagnostics and follow-up of medullary thyroid cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers highlighted the diagnostic challenges of measuring biomarkers in medullary thyroid cancer, emphasizing the need for standardized testing and careful interpretation.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic role of interim F-18 fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography-computed tomography during chemoradiation therapy in patients with hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: In patients with hypopharyngeal cancer, smaller reductions in tumor metabolic activity during chemoradiation predict higher disease recurrence risk.

biomarkers.title: EPB41L family serves as a prognostic biomarker for kidney renal clear cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: EPB41L family proteins are potential prognostic biomarkers for kidney cancer, with low expression linked to reduced survival and poor patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Acceptance and the willingness to pay for human papilloma virus (HPV) vaccine: A systematic review.
biomarkers.summary: A systematic review reveals HPV vaccine acceptance and willingness to pay vary globally, with knowledge, attitude, and socioeconomic factors influencing uptake across different income levels.

biomarkers.title: Apoptosis-related genes influence prognosis and immune characteristics of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Certain cell death-related genes significantly affect survival and immune response in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma patients.

trials.title: Cost of managing brain metastases in ALK-positive advanced NSCLC patients receiving first-line ALK TKIs in China.
trials.summary: Researchers analyzed the healthcare expenses associated with brain metastases in Chinese lung cancer patients treated with targeted ALK inhibitor drugs.
